articles.summary: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. (March 6, 2025) — The Arrow Family of Companies is proud to announce its 2024 giving, which resulted in total donations of $776,050, including $108,702 in employee contributions. Additionally, the Arrow team logged 11,902 volunteer hours, marking continued growth in community engagement. articles.title: Arrow Family of Companies Donates $776,000 and Logs Nearly 12,000 Volunteer Hours
